exposure: Gestational week at scheduled cesarean section (37th week vs. 39 weeks and above)
cohort: The study included 2318 pregnant women over 18 years of age with singleton pregnancies, without medication use or complicated pregnancies, who underwent four or more scheduled cesarean sections without labor or contractions.
finding: Transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) significantly increased in scheduled cesarean sections performed at the 37th week compared with other weeks, suggesting it is safe to wait until 39 weeks.
mod_finding: Scheduled cesarean sections performed at the 37th week significantly increased the risk of transient tachypnea of the newborn compared to later weeks, indicating it is safe to wait until 39 weeks.
